# Life in the UK Test (LITUT.uk) > Free online course and practice resource for the Life in the UK Test. ## Pages - [Home](https://litut.uk/): Overview of the Life in the UK Test site, study materials and links to practice tests and timelines. Recently updated to this month. - [Course](https://litut.uk/course/): Free Life in the UK Test course materials — modular lessons covering UK values, history, government, society, and practice questions. - [UK History Timeline](https://litut.uk/uk-history-timeline/): Interactive timeline covering major periods in UK history (from Stone Age to modern day). Considered by many one of the best tools to prepare for the test. - [Summaries](https://litut.uk/summaries/): Summary tables of key figures, for quick and easy review. - [Exams / Practice Tests](https://litut.uk/exams/): Real exam-style practice tests and timed mocks to prepare for the official test. - [FAQ](https://litut.uk/faq/): Frequently asked questions about booking, cost, eligibility, and other practical details. ## Description LITUT.uk provides study materials, a UK history timeline, summaries and real-exam-style practice tests to help citizenship and visa applicants (and others interested in UK history/civics) prepare for the Life in the UK Test. Key features: - Free study materials covering British history, government, society, and everyday life. - Interactive UK history timeline. - Practice/exam-style tests to simulate the actual Life in the UK Test. - FAQs providing guidance about the official test, booking, test validity, who needs to take it, etc. # LITUT.uk — Full Description & Key Information ## Basic Info - Website name: LITUT.uk - Primary purpose: Provide free online study materials, history summaries, UK-history timeline, and exam-style practice tests to help users prepare for the Life in the UK Test. ## What the site offers 1. **Study Materials** — The site covers a broad curriculum about British history, society and civics. Topics include (but are not limited to): early Britain, Roman Britain, Anglo-Saxon/Viking/Norman periods, Medieval Britain, Tudor/Stuart eras, British Enlightenment and Industrial Revolution, British Empire & Victorian era, 20th-century Britain (World Wars, social reforms), up to modern UK society — including culture, arts, sports, government, laws, and everyday life. 2. **UK History Timeline** — An interactive timeline to help learners visualise and understand the sequence of major events in UK history. 3. **Practice / Exam-style Tests** — Real-exam style tests mimicking the structure of the official Life in the UK Test (24 multiple-choice questions, timed, pass mark mimicking real test conditions). 4. **FAQs / Guidance** — Information on what the official test involves: who needs it (e.g. citizenship or ILR applicants), cost, validity, where/when it can be taken, and booking guidance. ## Target Users - People applying for British citizenship or Indefinite Leave to Remain (ILR). - Visa holders preparing for settlement. - Anyone interested in UK history, culture, government, and civic life — even outside a formal immigration context. ## How it Positions Itself - As a **free**, comprehensive, and accessible resource to lower barriers to preparation. - As a **self-study platform**, allowing users to learn at their own pace via materials, summaries, timeline, and tests. ## Limitations / What the Site Is *Not* - The site does **not** allow you to book the official Life in the UK Test — booking must be done via the official provider as specified by the government. - Practice tests are for revision and simulation — they are not the official exam and passing them does not equal official test success. ## Use Cases / How People Use It - As a **structured revision tool** before taking the Life in the UK Test. - To **build knowledge of UK history and society**, for integration, citizenship, or general interest. - For **self-paced learning**, esp. for people who want a flexible way to study outside of classes or formal courses. ## Other Info / Metadata - The site appears up-to-date - The navigation structure includes sections like: Study Materials, UK History Timeline, Practice Tests (Exams), Summaries, FAQ. --- ## Summary Statement LITUT.uk is a free-to-use online platform offering structured resources (study guides, UK-history timeline, summaries, and mock exams) to help learners — especially citizenship or settlement applicants — prepare for the Life in the UK Test, while also serving people generally interested in UK history, society, and civic knowledge. It is intended as a preparatory material for the official test.
